item.marvelous_menagerie.paleo_toolkit.d: Use on embedded fossil blocks to initiate an excavation!
item.marvelous_menagerie.steller_bucket: Bucket of Baby Steller's Sea Cow
effect.marvelous_menagerie.sea_cow_seren: Gives you thick skin like that of the Steller's Sea Cow to increase your resistance to damage and knockback, as well as granting you a little bit of water breathing.
effect.marvelous_menagerie.pacified.desc: Makes entities unable to attack or be attacked.
effect.marvelous_menagerie.hallucinating: Makes you see the world full of funny colors!
book.marvelous_menagerie.paleontology.tu: The Key to a Good Dig
painting.marvelous_menagerie.chud.title: Chud Anatomy
painting.marvelous_menagerie.chud.author: Ninni
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.root.de: Immerse yourself in a world with time magic!
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.paleono: Get your hands on a Paleonomicon! A book that will guide you through everything
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.paleo_t: Get yourself a trusty Paleontology Toolkit, essential to start digging fossils
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.obtain_: Obtain a Fossil from excavating an embedded stone block with a Paleontology Toolkit
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.perfect: I Like Digging In The Dirt!
Complete an Excavation perfectly, retrieving all 3 hidden fossils in time without breaking them
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.paleo_t: Use a Brush to clean a Fossil in the Paleontology Table to identify it!
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.ruined_: The Time Ritual That Time Forgot
Find a Ruined Altar while wandering in the world
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.chrono_: Craft a Chronotite Altar, the key piece for summoning creatures from the past
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.time_ri: A Rift In Time And Space
Find a rift in time that will open an abomination Fracture
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.chronot: Slay an abomination and obtain some of the metal coating their bodies
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.success: Successfully build an altar and create your own Time Fracture, essential for summoning creatures
Bring a creature back from the past for the first time

advancements.marvelous_menagerie.chud.de: Encounter a Chud, a pathetic deformed creature that emerged from a natural Time Fracture
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.beholde: Fall victim to a Beholder, a creature that locks you in place to behold you better
Encounter a Molten, a ferocious creature that can set you on fire!
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.anomalo: Can You See Into My Eyes?
Bear witness to Anomalocaris, Earth's first apex predator
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.apthoro: Not What You Want To See In Your Kitchen
Encounter an Apthoroblattina, a giant Carboniferous cockroach
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.arandas: Come face to face with Arandaspis, an early jawless fish
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.borealo: At This Time Of Year? In This Part Of The Country?
Encounter a Borealopelta, an armored dinosaur from the cretaceous
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.dawn_ho: The Early Horse Gets The Hay
Bring back a Dawn Horse, a tiny ancestor of modern horses
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.diploca: Come face to face with a Diplocaulus, an amphibious creature with a boomerang shaped head
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.dodo.de: Bring back a Dodo and make it unextinct!

Encounter a Doedicurus, a giant extinct armadillo

advancements.marvelous_menagerie.leptict: Take A Closer Look At That Snout!
Bring back a Leptictidium, a small bipedal mammal

Bring back a Pikaia, one of the earliest chordates

advancements.marvelous_menagerie.thylaci: Bring back a Thylacine, a skittish wolf-like marsupial

advancements.marvelous_menagerie.warning: Interacting with Hallucigenia might cause bright flashes in your screen. Proceed with caution!
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.anomalo: Craft a pair of Anomalous Goggles to allow you to better see underwater
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.ophthal: Craft an Ophthalmosaurus Armor out of Anomalocaris Sclerites to protect your underwater mount
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.jumbo_o: A Big Egg Makes A Giant Omelette
Craft a Jumbo Omelette, a wonderful foodsource that can give you regeneration for a short period of time
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.egg_she: Craft an Egg Shellmet, a helmet that will provide you with plenty of knockback resistance and a bit of slow falling
advancements.marvelous_menagerie.magic_r: Craft a Magic Pastry with Hallucigenic Mucus, a pastry that will grant you with speed and haste at the cost of hallucinating

advancements.marvelous_menagerie.flubber: Harvest the sweet products of a Flubber dig; Sessile animals!
